{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Filter to treatment arm
treatment_arm = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Compute response fraction
n_responded = treatment_arm['responded'].sum()
n_patients = len(treatment_arm)
fraction_responded = n_responded / n_patients

# Print all values that will be in evidence
print(f"n_patients: {n_patients}")
print(f"n_responded: {n_responded}")
print(f"fraction_responded: {fraction_responded}")"}
